introHtml: Custom bottle openers with zipper combine two practical tools into one compact giveaway. The built-in zipper pull makes them easy to attach to keychains, backpacks, or lunch bags, ensuring your logo stays visible wherever they go. Choose from metal or plastic bodies and imprint your brand with pad printing or laser engraving for a polished look that stands out at trade shows or employee appreciation events.
